question: Kulottunga I was a king of which of the following dynasties? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: Chola
Pandya
Rashtrakuta
Gurjara-Partihara
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Chola

Explanation:
Kulottunga I was a prominent king of the Chola dynasty, who ruled from 1070 CE to 1122 CE. He was the son of Rajendra Chola II and successfully conquered Sri Lanka, Kalinga, and the Kakatiya regions. He established diplomatic relations with Chinese rulers and promoted trade. His reign is considered the golden age of the Chola empire, marked by advancements in art, literature, and architecture. He renovated the Chidambaram Temple and strengthened the irrigation system in the Kaveri delta.

☛ What was the reign period of Kulottunga I? → 1070 CE to 1122 CE
☛ Who was the father of Kulottunga I? → Rajendra Chola II
☛ Which temple did Kulottunga I renovate? → Chidambaram Temple
☛ Which regions were conquered during Kulottunga I's reign? → Sri Lanka, Kalinga, and Kakatiya

पांड्य
राष्ट्रकूट
गुर्जर-प्रतिहार

Solution: सही उत्तर है चोल

Explanation:
कुलोत्तुंग I चोल राजवंश के महान राजा थे, जिन्होंने 1070 ई. से 1122 ई. तक शासन किया। वे चोल राजा राजेंद्र चोल द्वितीय के पुत्र थे और श्रीलंका, कलिंग तथा काकतीय क्षेत्रों पर विजय प्राप्त की। उन्होंने चीनी राजाओं के साथ कूटनीतिक संबंध स्थापित किए और व्यापार को बढ़ावा दिया। कुलोत्तुंग I के शासनकाल को चोल साम्राज्य का स्वर्ण युग माना जाता है, जहाँ कला, साहित्य और वास्तुकला का विकास हुआ। उन्होंने चिदंबरम मंदिर का जीर्णोद्धार कराया और कावेरी डेल्टा में सिंचाई व्यवस्था को सुदृढ़ किया।

question: Which of the following places was made the capital of the Rashtrakutas by Dantidurga? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Kannauj
Kanchi
Pataliputra
Manyakheta
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Manyakheta

Explanation:
The founder of the Rashtrakuta dynasty, Dantidurga, made Manyakheta (present-day Malkhed in Karnataka) his capital. After defeating the Chalukyas in the 8th century, Dantidurga established the Rashtrakuta empire and declared Manyakheta as its capital. This city later flourished under rulers like Amoghavarsha I and became a major political and cultural center in the Deccan region. Manyakheta remained the capital for most of the Rashtrakuta rule, from which they controlled large parts of southern and central India.

Explanation:

question: Who among the following founded Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty after winning Kannauj in the tripartite struggle? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: Rampal
Nagabhata I
Vatsaraja
Mihira Bhoja
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Nagabhata I

Explanation:
The Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty was founded by Nagabhata I after winning Kannauj in the tripartite struggle. This struggle took place between the Pala, Pratihara, and Rashtrakuta dynasties. Nagabhata I successfully repelled Arab invasions and expanded his kingdom. His successor was Vatsaraja, while Mihira Bhoja was the most famous ruler of the Pratihara dynasty. Rampal was the last ruler of the Pala dynasty.

☛ Most famous Pratihara ruler → Mihira Bhoja
☛ Invaders repelled by Nagabhata I → Arabs
☛ Capital of Pratiharas → Kannauj (Uttar Pradesh)
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किसने त्रिपक्षीय संघर्ष में कन्नौज जीतने के बाद गुर्जर-प्रतिहार वंश की स्थापना की? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 2)
options_hi: रामपाल
नागभट्ट प्रथम
वत्सराज
मीहिर भोज
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है नागभट्ट प्रथम

Explanation:
गुर्जर-प्रतिहार वंश की स्थापना नागभट्ट प्रथम ने की थी। उन्होंने त्रिपक्षीय संघर्ष में कन्नौज पर विजय प्राप्त की, जो पाल, प्रतिहार और राष्ट्रकूट राजवंशों के बीच हुआ था। नागभट्ट प्रथम ने अरब आक्रमणों को सफलतापूर्वक विफल किया और अपने राज्य का विस्तार किया। वत्सराज उनके उत्तराधिकारी थे, जबकि मीहिर भोज प्रतिहार वंश के सबसे प्रसिद्ध शासक थे। रामपाल पाल वंश के अंतिम शासक थे।

question: Which of the following Gurjara-Parthihara kings was highly praised by the Arabian scholar Sulaiman for keeping his empire safe from robbers? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: Vatsaraja
Ramabhadra
Mihira Bhoja
Nagabhata II
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Mihira Bhoja

Explanation:
The Gurjara-Pratihara king Mihira Bhoja (r. 836-885 CE) was highly praised by the Arab scholar Sulaiman in his book 'Silsilat-ut-Tawarikh'. Sulaiman noted that during Bhoja's reign, there were no thieves and the empire was completely safe from robbers. He considered the Pratihara kingdom as one of the most powerful states in India. Mihira Bhoja made Kannauj (Kanyakubja) his capital and assumed the title 'Adivaraha'. His empire extended from Multan in the west to Bengal in the east. He was a devout follower of Vishnu.

☛ What was the title of Mihira Bhoja? → Adivaraha

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस गुर्जर-प्रतिहार राजा की अरब विद्वान सुलेमान ने अपने साम्राज्य को लुटेरों से सुरक्षित रखने के लिए अत्यधिक प्रशंसा की थी? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 3)

Explanation:
गुर्जर-प्रतिहार वंश के राजा मिहिर भोज (836-885 ई.) को अरब विद्वान सुलेमान ने अपनी पुस्तक 'सिलसिला-उत-तवारीख' में अत्यधिक प्रशंसा की। सुलेमान ने लिखा कि मिहिर भोज के शासन में कोई चोर नहीं थे और लुटेरों से साम्राज्य पूरी तरह सुरक्षित था। उन्होंने प्रतिहार साम्राज्य को सबसे शक्तिशाली भारतीय राज्यों में गिना। मिहिर भोज ने अपनी राजधानी कन्नौज (कन्याकुब्ज) को बनाया और 'आदिवराह' की उपाधि धारण की। उनका साम्राज्य पश्चिम में मुल्तान से लेकर पूर्व में बंगाल तक फैला था। वे विष्णु के परम भक्त थे।

question: Which of the following was NOT a part of Shailendra Empire, founded in the South East Asia, in the 8th Century CE? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: Sumatra
Java
Srilanka
Malaya
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Srilanka

Explanation:
The Shailendra Empire was a prominent maritime empire in Southeast Asia from the 8th to 9th century CE, controlling key trade routes. It was primarily centered on the islands of Java and Sumatra, where it built magnificent Buddhist monuments like Borobudur. The Shailendra rulers also exerted influence over the Malay Peninsula and parts of Champa. However, Sri Lanka was never part of this empire; it was under the Anuradhapura Kingdom and was a separate political entity, though there were trade and cultural exchanges between the two regions.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Where was the Shailendra Empire centered? → Java and Sumatra
☛ Famous Buddhist stupa built by Shailendra kings? → Borobudur
☛ Which religion did the Shailendra dynasty patronize? → Buddhism (Mahayana)
☛ Century of Shailendra Empire's establishment? → 8th Century CE
☛ Regions under Shailendra rule? → Java, Sumatra, Malay Peninsula, Champa

Explanation:

question: Who among the following had one of their capitals at Benaras? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: Palas
Gahadavalas
Paramaras
Chahamanas
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Gahadavalas

Explanation:
The Gahadavala dynasty emerged in the 11th century in Kannauj and had its capital at Varanasi (Benaras) among other places. Prominent rulers of this dynasty include Chandradeva, Govindachandra, and Jayachandra. Chandradeva founded the Gahadavala dynasty in 1089 CE and made Varanasi his capital. Varanasi is referred to as 'Kashi' or 'Varanasi' in Gahadavala inscriptions. The Gahadavala rulers were patrons of art and literature. They primarily ruled the Gangetic plains.

☛ Who founded the Gahadavala dynasty? → Chandradeva
☛ What were the capitals of the Gahadavala dynasty? → Kannauj and Varanasi
☛ In which battle was Gahadavala king Jayachandra killed? → Battle of Chandawar (1194 CE)
☛ Who ended the Gahadavala dynasty? → Muhammad Ghori
☛ Which religion were the Gahadavala rulers patrons of? → Hinduism (especially Shaivism and Vaishnavism)
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किसके राज्यों में से एक बनारस में स्थित था? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 3)

गहड़वाल
परमार
चाहामान
solution_hi:

Explanation:
गहड़वाल राजवंश का उदय 11वीं शताब्दी में कन्नौज में हुआ और इसकी राजधानी वाराणसी (बनारस) सहित कई स्थान थे। इस वंश के प्रमुख शासकों में चंद्रदेव, गोविंदचंद्र और जयचंद्र शामिल हैं। चंद्रदेव ने 1089 ई. में गहड़वाल वंश की स्थापना की और वाराणसी को अपनी राजधानी बनाया। वाराणसी को गहड़वाल शिलालेखों में 'काशी' या 'वाराणसी' कहा गया है। गहड़वाल शासक कला और साहित्य के संरक्षक थे। वे मुख्यतः गंगा के मैदानी क्षेत्रों में शासन करते थे।

question: The kings of which among the following dynasties defeated the kings of Malaya, Java and Sumatra? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: Pandaya
Rashtrakuta
Chola
Chera
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Chola

Explanation:
The rulers of the Chola dynasty defeated the kings of Malaya, Java and Sumatra. The Chola Empire expanded its influence to Southeast Asia through its powerful navy. The Pandya, Rashtrakuta and Chera dynasties did not possess such naval power or reach.

question: Arrange the following rulers of the Pala dynasty in the chronological order (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 2)

solution:

Explanation:
The Pala dynasty was founded by Gopala. After him, Dharamapala (770-810 CE) ruled and expanded the empire in Bengal. Then Devapala (810-850 CE) succeeded, considered the most powerful Pala ruler. अंतिम पल्लव शासक अपराजितवर्मन था, जिसने 880-897 ई. तक शासन किया। पल्लव वंश दक्षिण भारत का एक प्रमुख राजवंश था, जो 3वीं से 9वीं शताब्दी तक शक्तिशाली रहा। इस वंश की राजधानी कांचीपुरम थी। अपराजितवर्मन के शासनकाल में पल्लवों का अंत हुआ, जब चोल राजा आदित्य प्रथम ने उसे हराकर पल्लव साम्राज्य को समाप्त कर दिया। पल्लव कला और वास्तुकला, विशेषकर रथ मंदिरों और गुफा मंदिरों के लिए प्रसिद्ध थे। उन्होंने संस्कृत और तमिल साहित्य को भी संरक्षण दिया।
